record.title: ApexOracle paper assets: embeddings, MIC scoring, and result-reproduction data

inherited_assets.boundary: All nine files present before this version are retained unchanged; their roles and hashes are chained through the immutable v4, v3 and v2 manifests.

new_files.role: source-partitioned public model-ready MIC, classification and synergy tables with compact strain/genome manifests
boundaries: The combined workstation MIC table was partitioned by the frozen numeric DBAASP identifier rule; all 15,718 private in-house rows were excluded.
CC BY 4.0 covers the capsule compilation and documentation and does not relicense underlying database records.
The separate result capsules remain authoritative for exact classification folds, the post-paper MIC reconstruction, and the high-confidence synergy replay boundary.
